title: Great Mop Heads; Terrible Fragrance Discs
text: Great Mop Heads; Terrible Fragrance Discs. These mop pads are great, but had to return the entire package because it contain their Spring Breeze Steam Mop Fragrance Discs, which absolutely stink.  It's not a fresh scent at all, and is so powerful that we all had runny eyes.  Buy the mop pad separately.
